verdict.rationale: Trello documents a REST API (auth flows, batch, search, webhooks), so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an OpenAPI or equivalent spec being published, and the probe found all common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on developer.atlassian.com returning 404. A REST API on its own does not satisfy this story, and the probe only checked guessed paths, so the absence is not fully confirmed.
